newsitem.title: USA: Enserch to file IRS supplemental on merger.
newsitem.headline: Enserch to file IRS supplemental on merger.

text.p: Enserch Corp said on Friday it will file a formal supplemental request with the U.S. Internal Revenue Service after the company found a misstatement of fact in its original filing regarding its proposed merger with Texas Utilities Co.
Enserch said in a news release it did not believe the misstatement was material. The supplemental request to confirm the ruling's reliability will be filed early next week.

The previously announced merger was subject to conditions that included a favorable tax ruling by the IRS. That ruling was issued in February, before Enserch discovered the misstatement, the company said.
The merger also is awaiting approval by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
Enserch is a natural gas company.
